notes.title: Optimization
notes.content:
[b]Hi, we made a small update because some people were having problems with FPS drops in certain parts of the game.[/b]

What changed?

[list]
[*] [b]General optimization:[/b] We made graphical changes and used optimization techniques to improve fps.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Removal of the restaurant scene:[/b] As many commented, we removed the restaurant scene as it did not add anything to the main story of the game and in addition it greatly lengthened the gameplay time.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Reduction in Build size:[/b] Using Unity techniques, we optimized the game's Build so that the game installation is not so large.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who is supporting my new series, you are amazing.
